## One-Param
### Conjugacy (Closed Form)

Data summarized:

```{r}
n_female <- nrow(df[(df$SEX == 'F'), ])
ntotal <- nrow(df)
paste ("mean of data: ", n_female / ntotal)
paste("total rows:", ntotal)
```




Posterior $\theta \sim \text{Beta}(2 + \sum y_i, 7 + n - \sum y_i)$ 

```{r}
#Beta Prior with ~22% E[X] -- (National Bureau of Justice Statistics).


set.seed(321)
closed_theta <- rbeta(1000, shape1 = 2 + n_female, shape2 = 7 + ntotal - n_female)

# use the 'posterior' package
posterior::as_draws(tibble(theta = closed_theta)) %>%
  summarize_draws()

```

### MCMC Stan / Convergence

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_bin <- list(N = ntotal, y = n_female)
code_bin <- "binom.stan"
fit_bin_mcmc <- stan(file = code_bin, data = data_bin,
                 chains = 4, seed = 321, iter = 2000,
                 refresh = 0)

#monitor(fit_bin)
```

```{r}
print(fit_bin_mcmc, pars = "theta")
```

The chain did converge because R-hat = 1.

### MCMC with Hyperparameter Search for Beta Prior


```{r}
#do a hyperparameter search for best beta prior to use with the same expected value (~0.22)
hyperparams <- list(
 alphas = c(2, 10, 22, 154),
 betas = c(7, 45, 78, 700)
)
```

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
prior_fits <- vector(mode = "list", length = 4)

for(i in 1:4) {
  data_bin <- list(N = ntotal, y = n_female, 
                   alpha = hyperparams$alphas[i], beta = hyperparams$betas[i])
  prior_fits[[i]] <- stan(file = "hyper_binom.stan", data = data_bin,
                 chains = 4, seed = 321, iter = 2000,
                 refresh = 0)
}
```

```{r}
#do a posterior check on decade:
ppc <- function(df, theta_samples, group) {
  y_tilde <- matrix(NA,
                    nrow = length(theta_samples),
                    ncol = length(df$SEX))
  
  y_tilde <- t(sapply(theta_samples, function(theta_s) {
      rbinom(length(df$SEX), 1, theta_s)
  }))
    
    
  bayesplot::ppc_stat_grouped(
      as.numeric(df$SEX == "F"),
      yrep = y_tilde,
      group = df[[group]]
  )
}
```

```{r}
results <- tibble(
  alpha = numeric(),
  beta  = numeric(),
  mean_theta = numeric(),
  sd_theta   = numeric(),
  hdi_lower  = numeric(),
  hdi_upper  = numeric()
)

for (i in 1:4) {
  alpha_i <- hyperparams$alphas[i]
  beta_i  <- hyperparams$betas[i]
  
  posterior <- rstan::extract(prior_fits[[i]])
  
  mean_theta <- mean(posterior$theta)
  sd_theta   <- sd(posterior$theta)
  hdi_vals   <- hdi(posterior$theta, ci = 0.90)
  
 
  results <- results %>%
    add_row(
      alpha      = alpha_i,
      beta       = beta_i,
      mean_theta = round(mean_theta, 3),
      sd_theta   = round(sd_theta, 3),
      hdi_lower  = round(hdi_vals[["lower"]], 3),
      hdi_upper  = round(hdi_vals[["upper"]], 3)
    )
}

print(results)
```

## Sequential Bayes Model


```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fits <- vector(mode = "list", length = 5)
years <- list(`1` = 2015, `2` = 2016, `3` = 2017,
              `4` = 2019, `5` = 2020) #there is no data for 2018

for (i in 1:5) {
  set.seed(321)
  curr_df <- df[df$YEAR == years[[i]], ]
  N <- table(curr_df$RPT.TIME24HR)
  y <- table(curr_df[curr_df$SEX == 'F', ]$RPT.TIME24HR) 
  
  if (i == 1) { #2015
    file = "hier_bin.stan"
    data =  list(J = 24, N = as.integer(N), y = as.integer(y)) 
  }
 
  
  else {
    prior <- rstan::extract(fits[[i - 1]])
    theta_priors <- colMeans(prior$theta)
    data = list(J = 24, N = as.integer(N), y = as.integer(y), mus = theta_priors)
    file = "hier_seq_bin.stan"
   
    
  }
  print(paste("Fitting year", years[[i]]))
  #fit new model
  fits[[i]] <-  stan(file = file, data = data,
                 chains = 4, seed = 321, iter = 2000,
                 refresh = 0)
  
}
```

## Final Models Evaluation
### Runtimes Check
```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(321)
### Runtimes of Closed form, (1) MCMC, MCMC Hyperparameter Search (prior), 
#3 Hierarchical Models, 1 Sequential Model

#closed form runtime:
closed <- function(df) {
  closed_theta <- rbeta(3000, shape1 = 2 + nrow(df[(df$SEX == 'F'), ]), 
                        shape2 = 7 + nrow(df) - nrow(df[(df$SEX == 'F'), ]))
  return (closed_theta)
}

#mcmc runtime 
mcmc_fit <- function(df) {
  fit_bin <- stan(file = "binom.stan", data = list(N = nrow(df), 
                 y = nrow(df[(df$SEX == 'F'), ])),
                 chains = 4, seed = 321, iter = 2000,
                 verbose = FALSE, refresh=0)
  return (fit_bin)
}

#hyperparameter check time
hyperparam_fit <- function(hyperparams, df) {
  prior_fits <- vector(mode = "list", length = 4)

  for(i in 1:4) {
    data_bin <- list(N = nrow(df), y = nrow(df[(df$SEX == 'F'), ]), 
                     alpha = hyperparams$alphas[i], beta = hyperparams$betas[i])
    prior_fits[[i]] <- stan(file = "hyper_binom.stan", data = data_bin,
                   chains = 4, seed = 321, iter = 2000,
                   refresh = 0)
  }
  return(prior_fits)
}

#Hierarchical time
hier_time_fit <- function(df, group) {
  J = length(table(df[[group]]))
  N = table(df[[group]])
  y = table(df[df$SEX == 'F', ][[group]])
  data_hier_bin <- list(J = J, N = as.integer(N), y = as.integer(y))
  hier_fit <- stan(file = "hier_bin.stan", data = data_hier_bin,
                 chains = 4, seed = 321, iter = 2000,
                 refresh = 0)
  return(hier_fit)
  
}

seq_time_fit <- function(years, df) {
  fits <- vector(mode = "list", length = 5)

  for (i in 1:5) {
    curr_df <- df[df$YEAR == years[[i]], ]
    N <- table(curr_df$RPT.TIME24HR)
    y <- table(curr_df[curr_df$SEX == 'F', ]$RPT.TIME24HR) 
    
    if (i == 1) { #2015
      file = "hier_bin.stan"
      data =  list(J = 24, N = as.integer(N), y = as.integer(y)) 
    }
   
    
    else {
      prior <- rstan::extract(fits[[i - 1]])
      theta_priors <- colMeans(prior$theta)
      data = list(J = 24, N = as.integer(N), y = as.integer(y), mus = theta_priors)
      file = "hier_seq_bin.stan"
     
      
    }
    print(paste("Fitting year", years[[i]]))
    #fit new model
    fits[[i]] <-  stan(file = file, data = data,
                   chains = 4, seed = 321, iter = 2000,
                   refresh = 0)
  }
  
  return(fits)
}


closed_theta_time <- system.time(closed_theta <- closed(df))

mcmc1fit_time <- system.time(mcmc1 <- mcmc_fit(df))

hyperparams <- list(alphas = c(2, 10, 22, 154),
                    betas = c(7, 45, 78, 700))

mcmc_hyperparam_time <- system.time(mcmc_hps <- hyperparam_fit(hyperparams, df))

hier_hour_time <- system.time(hier_24hr <- hier_time_fit(df, "RPT.TIME24HR"))
hier_race_time <- system.time(hier_race <- hier_time_fit(df, "RACE_GROUP"))
hier_age_time <- system.time(hier_age <- hier_time_fit(df, "DECADE"))

years <- list(`1` = 2015, `2` = 2016, `3` = 2017,
              `4` = 2019, `5` = 2020)
sequential_time <- system.time(seq_hiers <- seq_time_fit(years, df))
```

```{r}
all_times <- rbind(closed_theta_time, mcmc1fit_time, mcmc_hyperparam_time,
                   hier_hour_time, hier_race_time, hier_age_time, sequential_time)

all_times
```

```{r}
# Look at WAIC and LOOCV (LOOCV less unstable)

eval <- function(fit) {
  log_lik <- rstan::extract(fit)$log_lik
  if (length(dim(log_lik)) == 1) {
    log_lik <- matrix(log_lik, ncol = 1)
  }
  #waic_res <- waic(log_lik)
  loocv <- loo(log_lik)
  #print(waic_res)
  return(loocv)
}
```

```{r}
#prediction on 2021 dataset
pred <- function(fit, dfnew, group = NULL) {
  posterior <- extract(fit)
  theta <- posterior$theta
  
  if (!is.null(group)) {
    N2021 <- as.integer(table(dfnew[[group]]))
    #print(dfnew)
    n_groups <- length(N2021)
  } 
  
  else {
    N2021 <- nrow(dfnew)
    n_groups <- 1
  }
  
  n_draws <- nrow(theta)
  yrep_2021 <- matrix(
  rbinom(n_draws * n_groups,
         size = rep(N2021, each = n_draws),
         prob = as.vector(theta)),
  nrow = n_draws,
  ncol = n_groups
  )
  
  #yhat_2021 <- colMeans(yrep_2021) #means
  return (yrep_2021)
}
```

```{r}
       col = "lightblue",
       border = "white",
       breaks = 30)
  
  abline(v = y2021[j], col = "red", lwd = 2)  # observed value
}
```
